name: GJH Chibi Visitor
summary: Primary Blender-built GJH Chibi Visitor: an original static procedural interpretation with a happy face, white hoodie, wing fins, and headphones.
description: The primary Blender-built GJH Chibi Visitor is a static, one-metre procedural character with a rounded white helmet, purple happy face screen, wing fins, headphones, white hoodie, and GJH chest lettering.
author: Original owner-project procedural model
creation_method: Deterministic procedural character geometry and materials generated with Blender from generate.py and exported as glTF 2.0 GLB.
accuracy_notes: The owner's character-sheet image is private and is not redistributed. This procedural model is a close interpretation, not an exact match: it uses a symmetric standing pose rather than the hero illustration's waving hand, tilt, and perspective; mathematically regular helmet contours; fins that are thicker and more angular in three-quarter views; a slightly more rectangular visor with physical reflections; and Bfont mesh lettering rather than a trace of the sheet's GJH lettering. The hoodie collar is more geometric, the cloth has fewer folds, and the pocket seam is a procedural addition. Cuffs, shorts, and shoes are simplified solids. Inverted-hull outlines have uniform width, and PBR shading is not cel shading. Alternate expressions, outfits, and accessories are available in source builders and a visible kit library, not as selectable gallery variants or animated facial transitions. Exact sheet fidelity remains unverified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural character geometry and materials generated with Blender 5.2.3 LTS for the owner’s project; no third-party model is included.
Blender-bundled Bfont creates the GJH chest lettering as mesh geometry; no external font file is included.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
